comment: A pointer to the MCP servers this ecosystem operates.

There is no ratified well-known discovery format for 'which MCP servers does this domain run', so this file does not claim conformance to one and deliberately carries no $schema. It is a convenience. The load-bearing agent-facing surface on this site is /llms.txt, and the authority on what a server exposes is the server itself, over the standard tools/list request.

Authorization: the owner's decision (2026-09-29) is that the server is free with no sign-in, and auth is required only for the Fundi tools. That is live (mzizi-mcp 0.11.2, checked 2026-09-30): initialize and tools/list answer without a token, and only mzizi_fundi and mzizi_report_issue need sign-in.

servers.name: dev.mzizi/registry
servers.title: Mzizi registry
servers.description: The Mzizi component registry, skills and docs as MCP tools: one call returns everything about a component rather than several.

authorization.note: Free, no sign-in, except the Fundi tools: anything that files into the Fundi issue desk or needs a console user requires OAuth.
